description.p: TotalArchery is an all-in-one app for archers. It builds sight tapes from your setup's real physics, walks you through bow tuning, times your arrow with just a microphone, and gives you coaching feedback that is tailored to you.

ul.li: Sight tapes: generate, calibrate and print a tape for your bow and arrow.
Tuning: paper, bare-shaft and walk-back tuning, step by step.
Scoring: rounds and 3D courses, with group analysis from where your arrows land.
Chronograph: arrow speed from the sound of the release and the impact.
Gear: keep track of your bows, arrows and equipment.

description.p: The app is a free download. A TotalArchery account keeps your data backed up and synced across your devices, and a subscription ($23.99 per year, with a 14-day free trial) is started from inside the app.
